args.prompt: @Video1 is a plain grey 3D clay render of ONE continuous 6-second shot: the camera glides from the terrace of a 16th-floor apartment through its open glass sliding door and travels into the living room, ending in the middle of the room looking at the far wall with the front door. Re-render the SAME footage as a photoreal architectural visualization: keep every frame's camera motion, perspective and horizon, every wall, column, opening, door, the slider frames and every piece of furniture exactly where @Video1 draws them; only replace the clay materials with real ones. Nothing static may change shape, count or position between frames. The room must look EXACTLY like the real room photographed in @Image2 to @Image6; copy its furniture, colours and materials, and add nothing that is not in them. @Image1 shows only the terrace of the FIRST frame: the pale stone terrace floor, the glass railing with its pale handrail and the slim black-framed floor-to-ceiling sliding glazing with sheer cream curtains. The flat grey rectangle in @Image1 is a blank placeholder, not a wall: there the room is seen through the glass, and it follows @Image2 to @Image6. @Image2 is the view the shot ends on: a pale natural oak parquet floor of long straight planks; warm white plastered walls; a plain WHITE flush front door with a small black lever and the same white flush interior doors; a small light-oak console with a ceramic vase of green fern and a framed beige abstract print above it, beside the front door; a flat white ceiling with a few small recessed spots. @Image3 is the wall on the LEFT of the shot: a greige textured plaster wall with a wall-mounted black TV above a long low sand-grey floating unit; a floor lamp with a cream drum shade by the curtain. @Image4 is the RIGHT side of the shot: a handleless sand-grey kitchen with a lit open shelf of ceramics, a built-in black oven and a tall cabinet. @Image5 shows the seating from above: a low modular cream boucle sofa with a chaise end and beige-and-cream square cushions, NO blanket and NO throw on it; in front of it a low OVAL pale travertine coffee table carrying two books, a small stone bowl and a white vase of green fern; under them a pale CREAM textured RECTANGULAR rug (not round, not jute, not brown). @Image6 shows the round cream boucle swivel armchair standing on the bare parquet, and the floor near the front door. There is no round rug, no jute rug, no blanket, no extra plants and no extra furniture anywhere. Soft bright hazy morning daylight, neutral white, consistent exposure throughout. Smooth, continuous, no cuts, no text, no people, no watermark.
